name: Plate XXXVII: The Sri Yantra
description: Nine interlocking triangles, four of Shiva and five of Shakti, radiating from the bindu: the cosmos as a diagram of union. Struck in Lapis Lazuli: ground lapis, the stone of the night sky and of Egyptian heaven. Degree of Adept, rank 122 of the folio. “LVX E TENEBRIS”: Light out of darkness.
